mentions.name: VideoToFlip
mentions.description: Service that turns short videos into handmade 72-page flipbooks, printed, bound, and shipped in-house from a workshop in Serbia. Since launch it added a frame-by-frame preview before checkout showing the exact frames that will print, and moved printing fully in-house. Sells many orders as wedding favors and paper-anniversary gifts.
mentions.audience: People ordering wedding favors and paper-anniversary gifts
mentions.source_excerpt: Still running VideoToFlip — we turn short videos into handmade 72-page flipbooks (print/bind/ship in-house from our workshop in Serbia).
mentions.author: momciloo
